globalThis.comparison = new Promise(resolve => {
  const checks = {};
  const throwsTypeError = run => { try { run(); return false; } catch (error) { return error instanceof TypeError; } };
  checks.activeVisibility = document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hidden === false;
  checks.visibilityReadonly = Reflect.set(document, 'visibilityState', 'hidden') === false;
  checks.hiddenReadonly = Reflect.set(document, 'hidden', true) === false;
  const visibilityGetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Document.prototype, 'visibilityState');
  checks.visibilityEnumerable = visibilityGetter.enumerable === true;
  checks.visibilityBrand = throwsTypeError(() => visibilityGetter.get.call({}));
  Object.defineProperty(document, 'visibilityState', {value:'hidden', configurable:true});
  checks.hiddenIgnoresShadow = document.hidden === false;
  delete document.visibilityState;
  document.body.hidden = true;
  checks.elementHiddenIndependent = document.hidden === false;
  document.body.hidden = false;
  checks.missingCallback = throwsTypeError(() => requestAnimationFrame());
  checks.nullCallback = throwsTypeError(() => requestAnimationFrame(null));
  checks.objectCallback = throwsTypeError(() => requestAnimationFrame({handleEvent(){}}));
  checks.invalidProvider = throwsTypeError(() => requestAnimationFrame.call({}, () => {}));
  checks.invalidCancelProvider = throwsTypeError(() => cancelAnimationFrame.call({}, 1));
  checks.missingHandle = throwsTypeError(() => cancelAnimationFrame());
  checks.bigintHandle = throwsTypeError(() => cancelAnimationFrame(1n));
  checks.symbolHandle = throwsTypeError(() => cancelAnimationFrame(Symbol()));
  checks.unknownHandle = cancelAnimationFrame(123456) === undefined;
  const order = [];
  let firstTime = 0, canceled = false, duplicateCount = 0, early = true;
  let errorCount = 0;
  const errorListener = event => {
    if (event.error?.message === 'frame-' + variant) { errorCount++; event.preventDefault(); }
  };
  addEventListener('error', errorListener);
  const first = requestAnimationFrame(function(time) {
    'use strict';
    checks.strictReceiver = this === undefined;
    checks.asynchronous = !early;
    checks.timestamp = typeof time === 'number' && Number.isFinite(time) && time > 0;
    checks.clock = time <= performance.now();
    firstTime = time;
    order.push('first');
    document.getElementById('value').textContent = String(variant);
    queueMicrotask(() => { order.push('micro'); cancelAnimationFrame(second); });
    setTimeout(() => order.push('timer'), 0);
    requestAnimationFrame(function(later) {
      'use strict';
      order.push('nested');
      checks.nestedLater = later > firstTime;
      checks.canceledPending = !canceled;
      checks.microtaskCheckpoint = order.join(',') === 'first,micro,last,timer,nested';
      checks.duplicateCallbacks = duplicateCount === 2;
      checks.reportedException = errorCount === 1;
      checks.domMutation = document.getElementById('value').textContent === String(variant);
      removeEventListener('error', errorListener);
      resolve(checks);
    });
  });
  const second = requestAnimationFrame(() => { canceled = true; });
  const last = requestAnimationFrame(time => {
    order.push('last');
    checks.sameTimestamp = time === firstTime;
    checks.lastSeesMutation = document.getElementById('value').textContent === String(variant);
  });
  checks.independentHandles = first === 1 && second === 2 && last === 3;
  const duplicate = () => { duplicateCount++; };
  const fourth = requestAnimationFrame(duplicate);
  const fifth = requestAnimationFrame(duplicate);
  checks.duplicateHandles = fourth !== fifth;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { throw new Error('frame-' + variant); });
  const removed = requestAnimationFrame(() => { canceled = true; });
  checks.cancelResult = cancelAnimationFrame(String(removed) + '.9') === undefined;
  checks.timerHandleUnchanged = setTimeout(() => {}, 0) === 1;
  early = false;
});
